name: Debrief & Purple Teaming
description: Ability to conduct post-operation debriefs, replay attack paths with defenders, and facilitate purple team exercises. Covers translating red team findings into actionable defensive improvements, collaborative attack replay, detection gap analysis, and building constructive relationships with blue teams.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to red team debriefs or purple teaming

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose of debriefs and the concept of purple teaming
evidence: Completed training on purple team methodology
Can explain why debrief and attack replay add value beyond a written report
Understands the collaborative (not adversarial) nature of purple teaming

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Participates in debriefs and purple team sessions under senior guidance
evidence: Presented specific attack steps during a debrief with supervision
Participated in purple team sessions replaying techniques in a lab environment
Contributed to detection gap documentation under guidance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts debriefs and facilitates purple team sessions
evidence: Led 3+ post-engagement debriefs with client defensive teams
Facilitated purple team replay sessions resulting in new detection rules
Produced detection gap analysis reports with actionable recommendations
Maintained professional, collaborative rapport with blue teams

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Designs purple team programmes; handles complex multi-stakeholder debriefs
evidence: Designed structured purple team exercise programmes for clients
Conducted separate debriefs tailored to both executive and technical audiences within the same engagement
Developed detection engineering recommendations tied to specific MITRE ATT&CK techniques
Mentors team on effective debrief facilitation and stakeholder management

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab debrief and purple team methodology; recognised industry contributor
evidence: Authored the lab's purple teaming methodology and debrief standards
Developed frameworks for measuring defensive improvement over time
Delivers training on purple teaming and debrief techniques
Presents on purple team methodology at industry conferences

assessment_methods.description: Observe facilitation of a debrief or purple team session, assessing communication clarity, technical accuracy, and collaborative tone
Review detection gap analysis reports and purple team exercise outputs from recent engagements
